description: This file defines the JsValidator class, which provides static methods to validate JavaScript code snippets by checking for disallowed keywords such as 'async', 'await', 'Promise', and 'setTimeout'. It includes logic to ignore comments and string literals during validation.

classes.name: JsValidator
classes.description: A utility class for validating JavaScript code snippets to ensure they do not contain certain asynchronous constructs or functions.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the provided script body string to ensure it does not contain 'async', 'await', 'Promise', or 'setTimeout'. Returns an error message if disallowed keywords are found, otherwise null.
